Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Learned A.G.A has contended that the notice has been served on the respondent.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned A.G.A and perused the entire record.

This criminal appeal under Section 14-A (2) Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been preferred by the appellant with a prayer to set aside the bail rejection order dated 20.1.2023 passed by learned Special Judge SC/ST Act/Additional Session Judge, Ghaziabad in Case Crime No.847 of 2022, under sections 376, 506 I.P.C and Section 3(2) V of SC/ST Act, Police Station Masoorie, District Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Special Judge SC/ST Act/Additional Session Judge, Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that in this case there is an allegation of commission of rape by the appellant with the victim who is married lady aged about 40 years.

As per Salauddin Alias Sirajuddin vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174057002/
1 allegation made in the F.I.R when she went with her brother on the shop of the appellant, the brother of victim was sent somewhere by the appellant and she was subjected to rape inside the shop.

entities.text: Salauddin Alias Sirajuddin vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the incident is said to have taken place in the broad day light in the medical shop which is a public place where the presence of people cannot be denied and in presence of people such act cannot be committed.

It is further submitted that the rape is said to have been committed by force but during medical examination no any injury either internal or external was found on the person of the victim which shows that no force or violence has been used against her.
There is no any pathological or forensic report to show that rape was committed with her.
It is also submitted that there was money dispute between the brother of victim and the appellant that was the reason the present F.I.R was lodged against him with false allegation.
The appellant is in jail since 26.11.2022 having no criminal antecedent but learned Special Judge did not consider all these facts while rejecting the bail, therefore, requested for bail.
Learned A.G.A opposite the aforesaid prayer.
I have considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned A.G.A and have gone through the entire record including the impugned order carefully.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, the period appellant remained in jail, the Court is of the opinion that the appellant has made out a case for bail.
The Court below erred in rejecting the bail application.
The impugned order suffers from infirmity and illegality and the same is liable to be set-aside and the appeal is to be allowed.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.

Let the appellant- Salauddin Alias Sirajuddin, involved in the aforesaid Case Crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two heavy sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The appellant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The appellant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The appellant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The appellant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which they are accused, or suspected, of the commission of which they are suspected.

5. The appellant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Salauddin Alias Sirajuddin vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174057002/
2 Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
